title: ESQET Axiom 4: Non-Perturbative Higgs Correction from Non-Orientable Vacuum
description: The non-orientable vacuum (Axiom 2) induces a universal 1/(8π²) loop factor in all instanton processes. The leading non-perturbative correction to the Higgs potential is the dimension-6 operator Δℒ = + c₆ (H†H)³/M_Pl² with positive coefficient c₆ = O(1) derived from the topological θ-term on ℳ_vac. The Higgs trilinear self-coupling deviates positively from the Standard Model: κ_λ - 1 = + C·(v/M_Pl)²·1/(8π²) with C > 0.
